package example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities

import net.imadz.common.CborSerializable

object CreditBalanceEntity {
  final case class State(
    availableAmount: BigDecimal,
    reservedTotal: BigDecimal,
    reservedByTx: Map[String, BigDecimal]
  )

  def empty: State = State(
    availableAmount = BigDecimal("0.00"),
    reservedTotal = BigDecimal("0.00"),
    reservedByTx = Map()
  )

  def empty(availableAmount: BigDecimal): State = empty.copy(availableAmount = availableAmount)

  sealed trait Event extends CborSerializable
  final case class FundsReserved(txId: String, amount: BigDecimal) extends Event

  type EventHandler = (State, Event) => State
}
